# 1418 — Managed-service version drift: inventory job + event/ticket sink

Board: https://maestromojo.com/workspaces/#/board/11?item=1418
Stage at claim: planned -> building (maestro-auto batch with #1417, #1419)

## Approved scope (user decision at the gate, 2026-08-06)

Build the deterministic core only:
- monthly/daily inventory of RDS + ElastiCache major-version drift and published
  end-of-support deadlines
- report_event into `system:health:aws_versions`, opt-in RuleSet at category
  `aws:versions` -> ticket -> existing maestro board plumbing

Deferred to a follow-up item: CloudWatch traffic-trough window, the AMI leg, and
the LLM release-note risk assessment.

**Approved fix**: rename the RuleSet category to `aws:versions` AND narrow the
over-broad guard in `mojo/apps/incident/cronjobs.py:10-19`
(`category__startswith="system:health:"`) to the three names
`ensure_health_rules()` actually creates, with a regression test. Left as-is, the
guard would let this item permanently suppress `Health - Runner Down` /
`Scheduler Missing` / `TCP Overload`.

The full plan, challenge dispositions and contracts live on the board item.
